newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Two killed, 37 injured in Taiwan fire.
newsitem.headline: Two killed, 37 injured in Taiwan fire.

text.p: Fire swept through a 14-storey apartment building in Taiwan's capital on Tuesday night, killing two people and injuring at least 37, a police official said on Wednesday.

"The fire killed two people and at least 37 were injured," the official said by telephone. "One jumped out of the building from the eighth floor to the ground, and we found the other body after the fire was extinguished."
He said police were investigating the cause, and did not rule out the possibility of arson.
The fire started on the sixth floor and raced through several storeys above before 280 firefighters with 54 fire engines quelled it more than two hours later.
The same building was the site of another fire in 1984 that killed 19 people.
Also on Tuesday, another fire in the northern city of Panchiao triggered by an explosion of motorcycles roared through several houses, killing one person and injuring 18, the police official said.
